title: Report of Committee, 5 February 1841
handwriting: Handwriting of Robert B. Thompson and JS
source_note: Committee (including JS) on Vacating the Town Plats of Commerce and Commerce City, Report, to the Nauvoo City Council, Nauvoo, Hancock Co., IL, 5 Feb. 1841; handwriting of Robert B. Thompson and JS; signature of JS; Nauvoo, IL, Records, CHL. Includes docket, mathematical equations, and archival markings. Single leaf measuring 8¾ × 7¾ inches (22 × 20 cm). Fragments of a signature at the top of the recto show that the document was cut from a larger leaf. The document is ruled with twenty-six horizontal lines and one vertical line, all in blue ink (now faded). The document was inscribed in blue and brown ink and has four horizontal filing folds. Nauvoo city records were kept in the Church Historian’s Office as early as the 1840s. This report appears to have been in institutional custody since its creation.
